translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: Gumazim uabɨn akuragh mɨdorozim damuasa God ko mɨgei
A gumazir onger akabar faragha zuim gɨnɨghnɨgha an osiri.

content.text: Nɨ osɨmtɨzim ikiamin dughiamɨn, Ikiavɨra Itir God nɨn dɨmdiam ikaragh nɨn akurvagham.
A en ovavim Jekopɨn God, a nɨ geghuv nɨn ganam.
A Saionɨn Mɨghsɨamɨn ikia uan Dɨpenimɨn iti,
egh a uan akurvazim nɨ bagh anemadagh gavgavim nɨ danɨngam.
Ofan nɨ a bagha amiba, a bar dagh nɨghnɨgh,
egh nɨn ofan bar isia mɨghɨribagh ifuegham.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: Nɨ bizir tizim gifuegha navim a bagha nɨ dɨkafi,
God a isɨ nɨ danɨngam.
Bizir nɨ damuasa nɨghnɨziba,
a dar amightɨ da bar otivigham.
Nɨ uan apanibav sogh me abɨraghtɨ,
e bizir kam bagh bar akuegham.
E bizir kam gɨnɨghnɨgh uan Godɨn ziam fam.
E ghaze, nɨ Ikiavɨra Itir Godɨn azangsɨzir biziba,
an ada ikaragh da isɨ nɨ danɨngam.
Kɨ datɨrɨghɨn fo, Ikiavɨra Itir God,
uabɨ uan atrivir a ua baghavɨra mɨsevezir kam, an an akurvasi.
A uan Nguibar aghuimɨn ikia, an azangsɨziba barasi.
Egha uan gavgavimɨn an akurvazima,
a mɨdorozimɨn uan apaniba abɨri.
Gumazir maba nɨghnɨzir gavgavim uan mɨdorozir karisbar ikia ghaze, da men akurvagham.
Ezɨ marazi nɨghnɨzir gavgavim uan hoziabar ikia ghaze, da men akurvagham.
Ezɨ eia, e nɨghnɨzir gavgavim uan Ikiavɨra Itir Godɨn ziamɨn ikia
kamaghɨn fo, a en akurvagham.
Gumazamizir kamaghɨn amiba,
me asaghpora ira bar puvarɨsi.
E puvatɨ.
E dɨkavigh tuivigh gavgavigham.
O Ikiavɨra Itir God,
nɨ atrivimɨn akuraghtɨ a uan apaniba abɨnigh.
E nɨn deir dughiabar,
nɨ en dɨmdiam ikaragh en akuragh.
